evidence.quote: Question 8.4. χkQ ̸= 0 ∈ H 2k (BDiffω+ (S1 )δ ; Q) for k ≥ 2 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)$ denote the group of orientation-preserving real-analytic diffeomorphisms of the circle $S^1$, and let $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)^{\delta}$ denote the same group equipped with the discrete topology. Let $B\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)^{\delta}$ be its classifying space. The action of $\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)$ on $S^1$ gives rise to a universal flat oriented circle bundle over $B\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)^{\delta}$, whose rational Euler class is denoted
$$\chi_{\mathbb{Q}} \in H^{2}\bigl(B\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)^{\delta};\,\mathbb{Q}\bigr).$$
For each integer $k \geq 2$, decide whether the $k$-th cup power
$$\chi_{\mathbb{Q}}^{k} \in H^{2k}\bigl(B\mathrm{Diff}^{\omega}_{+}(S^1)^{\delta};\,\mathbb{Q}\bigr)$$
is nonzero.
artifact.category_tag: Euler class of flat circle bundles
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an open problem in a 2025 problem list on foliations and diffeomorphism groups. For smooth diffeomorphisms, Morita proved all powers of the rational Euler class are nonzero. For analytic diffeomorphisms, an unpublished theorem attributed to Thurston asserts that the cube of the Euler class vanishes rationally, while Nariman showed that integral powers of the Euler class are nonzero. The general rational case for $k \geq 2$ does not appear to be settled in the literature.

status_evidence.title: On powers of the Euler class for flat circle bundles (Nariman)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Thurston's claim that e^3 = 0 rationally for analytic diffeomorphisms, contrasting with Morita's nonvanishing result for smooth diffeomorphisms, and shows integral powers are nonzero.
status_evidence.claim: The rational Euler class powers for B Diff^ω_+(S^1)^δ are not known to be nonzero in general; an unpublished Thurston theorem suggests vanishing for k=3.

status_evidence.title: Problem list on Foliations and Diffeomorphism groups (arXiv:2503.18274)
status_evidence.snippet: Compiled problem list including Question 8.4 in the section on real analytic foliations.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as an open question in a 2025 problem list.
